verdict.rationale: Khoj documents a first-party WhatsApp client: you can chat with Khoj on WhatsApp without any desktop clients, and slash commands like /online work there. No other messenger named in the story is evidenced; the other documented surfaces are Emacs, Obsidian, the desktop app and the web browser. Missing for 10: Telegram, Discord, Slack and iMessage support, plus independent or hands-on confirmation that the WhatsApp integration works.
